notes.title: Early Access Update #2
notes.content:
Hey guys just a small update here, fixing some stuff and improving some of the levels mostly. 

*Whats new*
- Level Design changes to levels 3, 4, 7, 8, 9, decreasing difficulty and providing more options to progress
- Added a gliding frog dude to the beginning area to demonstrate how the glider works (more of this kind of thing to come)
- Added a "Restart Level" button and a "Return To Pond" button to the pause menu
- Hid a few more Golden Lilypads around the pond
- Added a few more trees and details around the world
*Bug fixes and Improvements*
- Increased the pickup radius for Golden Lilypads
- Fixed a movement problem where your velocity would get reset when jumping into a wall, which was really annoying. You will now keep your momentum when jumping and velocity is only reset if falling, so now it is much easier to get up on platforms that are right in front of you.
- Fixed Level Select UI above level buttons not showing sometimes
- Fixed the Gold Lilypad on level 5 that couldn't be picked up (again, its actually fixed this time haha)

Please report any bugs you find to me by joining Discord or in GOPOGOs Steam Community Forum!

[url=https://discord.gg/8kb8fQZ6SS]Join the Commmunity Discord[/url]

Cheers!
- Timothy

notes.title: Early Access Update #1
notes.content:
Firstly, thank you for playing my game! 

30 people have purchased the game so far and that makes me very proud. Its a relief to finally get this game up on the store after 6 months of hard work. I've never made a multiplayer game before or a game with a replay system, so it was pretty challenging.

I know that GOPOGO is lacking in content right now and that the tutorial lacking / non-existent but I will be addressing that soon. The game is more difficult for a lot of people than I had initially thought, especially gliding, not many people are intuitively figuring out how to glide long distances, so I will need to add a tutorial teaching how to glide at the beginning of the game I think.

I have a lot of work to do on this game still and you can expect many regular updates, this is just the beginning. I have a lot of ideas for this game, including multiplayer gamemodes and coop levels. I also want to make it so you can go inside the house, of course.

Anyway, here is whats new in this update:
- Graphics Improvement: Added Sun shafts / God rays
- Added some more trees and details around the pond,
- Fixed Golden Lilypad that couldn't be picked up on level 5,
- Fixed Pause Respawn Button not working, oops

Please report any bugs you find to me by joining Discord or in GOPOGOs Steam Community Forum!

[url=https://discord.gg/8kb8fQZ6SS]Join the Commmunity Discord[/url]

More updates soon, thanks everyone!
- Timothy

notes.title: GOPOGO Demo Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
[b]The GOPOGO Demo[/b] has received a Major Update and you can now race your friends in Multiplayer! There are also new levels, race challenges and new obstacles including Pesky Birds, Jumping Piranhas, Rolling Boulders and more!

I've also added language support for 13 languages, please let me know if you see any bad translations!

I'm very excited to release GOPOGO in Early Access as soon as possible, hopefully later this month.
Thank you for playing!
- Timothy
